components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Main call to action on hero, forms, and submission confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background-color: #4F46E5; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #4338CA; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Neutral Button
components.description: Secondary actions, cancel, modal dismissal, or filter triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #0F172A; background-color: #F1F5F9; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #E2E8F0; color: #0F172A; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Category Filter Pill
components.description: Horizontal category filter selectors with tabular counters.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background-color: #4F46E5; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip-count { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Verified Provenance Ribbon
components.description: Corner-clipped badge indicating community or receipt OCR provenance.
components.css: .ds-verified-ribbon { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #ffffff; background-color: #10B981; border-top-right-radius: 16px; border-bottom-left-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); }

components.name: Price Card Surface
components.description: Primary container for product listings and store comparisons.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.9); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(199, 210, 254, 0.8); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0F172A; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #0F172A; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview: OpenPrice is a friendly, civic crowdsourced price intelligence and inflation tracking platform. It rejects sterile financial grayness and discount spam in favor of an energetic, welcoming, and intuitive consumer experience with verified shelf-tag OCR provenance, clear economic signals, and robust methodology transparency.
keyCharacteristics: Subtle Ambient Lift and Crisp 1px Framing
Strict Tabular Numeral Invariant on All Financial Figures
Zero AI Clutter or Decorative Slop
Verified Multimodal Provenance with Corner-Clipped Ribbons

rules.name: The Price Direction Rule
rules.body: Color is never arbitrary on price figures: emerald green strictly represents price drops and savings; coral sunset red strictly represents price increases, hikes, and inflation; neutral slate represents stable prices.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All monetary amounts, percentage deltas, timestamps, and chart axis labels must use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so numbers do not cause layout shifts during live updates.

rules.name: The 44px Touch Target Rule
rules.body: All interactive controls, category pills, buttons, and navigation triggers must have a minimum bounding box of 44x44px for reliable mobile touch ergonomics.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for all price amounts and delta percentages.
Do pair emerald green with price decreases and coral red with price increases.
Do preserve the 44px minimum touch target on all interactive buttons and filters.
Do display verification provenance (shelf photo, receipt OCR, flyer) alongside prices.
donts: Don't use em-dashes (—) in headlines, eyebrows, buttons, or microcopy.
Don't add generic AI sparkles or gradient mesh blobs.
Don't use red for price savings or green for price hikes.
Don't allow number text to render without tabular-nums.
